responsibility: Implements the core bit-value and bit-expression object model used by the symbolic executor to represent variables as vectors of constants, symbolic bits, and derived per-bit expressions. This file defines constructors, deep-copy behavior, accessors, ownership/destruction of expression operands, and dump printing for symbolic_bit, bit, and the arithmetic/bitwise expression node classes, producing the fundamental expression trees that later state operations and conditions manipulate.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation for the expression IR declared in sym-exec-expression.h: constructors, deep-copy/destruction, accessors, and dump printing for symbolic_bit, bit, and bit_expression subclasses. Unlike the header, it realizes the runtime behavior of the core bit/expression nodes rather than defining their types and inheritance structure.
